name: eduerp-v2-monorepo
description: EduERP v2.0 B2B Turnkey Platform — Center Data Plane API, Outbox Worker, Shared Contracts, PostgreSQL/Prisma 7 Foundation, and Staff Auth/RBAC (Stages 04–09)

scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@eduerp/contracts run build && npm --workspaces run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run build && npm --workspaces --if-present run test
scripts.test:db: npm run build && npm --workspace=@eduerp/api run test:db
scripts.test:auth: npm run build && npm --workspace=@eduerp/api run test:auth
scripts.test:students: npm run build && npm --workspace=@eduerp/api run test:students
scripts.test:academics: npm run build && npm --workspace=@eduerp/api run test:academics
scripts.test:billing: npm run build && npm --workspace=@eduerp/api run test:billing
scripts.test:adjustments: npm run build && npm --workspace=@eduerp/api run test:adjustments
scripts.test:payments: npm run build && npm --workspace=@eduerp/api run test:payments
scripts.test:cash: npm run build && npm --workspace=@eduerp/api run test:cash
scripts.test:attendance: npm run build && npm --workspace=@eduerp/api run test:attendance
